title: Forks: two targets at once
summary: Attack two pieces with one move.

steps.text: A **fork** is a move that attacks two (or more) enemy pieces at once. The opponent can only save one. Knights are the best forkers because their attack pattern is so unusual - and a fork that also gives check is the most powerful, because the opponent must answer the check first.

steps.prompt: Fork the king and the rook.
steps.hint: Look for a square a knight's move from both e8 and a8.
steps.success: Nc7+! After the king moves, the knight takes the rook.
